query:
SELECT 
  u.id as user_id,
  u.name as user_name,
  u.role as user_role,
  u.custom_role_id,
  cr.name as custom_role_name,
  rp.module,
  rp.submodule,
  rp.permission_level
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN custom_roles cr ON u.custom_role_id = cr.id
LEFT JOIN role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id = cr.id
WHERE u.role = 'manutencao'
ORDER BY rp.module, rp.submodule;
